text.zh: 在伦敦东区工人阶级街区上小学，与 Lynn、Sue 同校。
text.en: Attends primary school in a working-class part of London's East End, with Lynn and Sue.

text.zh: 家中五个女儿之一；她送妹妹上学。
text.en: One of five daughters; she takes her little sister to school.

text.zh: 在伦敦东区长大；影片在伦敦一处市政住宅区介绍她出场。
text.en: Grows up in London's East End; the film introduces her on a London council estate.

text.zh: 她说妈妈生了五个女儿是因为“倒了七年霉”，全家曾盼新生儿是男孩。
text.en: She says her mum has five girls because of seven years' bad luck; the family had hoped the new baby would be a boy.

text.zh: 在综合中学就读；东区三个女孩中只有 Lynn 选了文法学校。
text.en: At a comprehensive school; of the three East End girls, only Lynn chose grammar school.

text.zh: 被问是否想发财时，她说只想过得舒舒服服。
text.en: Asked whether she wants to be rich, she says she would just like to live comfortably.

text.zh: 前一年 19 岁时嫁给了 Mick。
text.en: Married to Mick since the year before, when she was 19.

text.zh: 住在伦敦郊外埃塞克斯一处新住宅区的新房里。
text.en: Lives in a new house on a new estate in Essex, on the outskirts of London.

text.zh: 前一年与 Mick 结婚，并搬到埃塞克斯的新住宅区。
text.en: Married Mick the previous year and moved to a new estate in Essex.

text.zh: 在市区的一家保险公司工作。
text.en: Works for an insurance company in the city.

text.zh: 19 岁嫁给装修工 Mick；她已决定不要孩子。
text.en: Married at 19 to Mick, a decorator; she has decided not to have children.

text.zh: 她承认某种程度上有所错过，但觉得没有孩子的牵绊收获更多。
text.en: She admits she is missing out to a degree, but feels she gains far more experience without the tie of children.

text.zh: 儿子出生后休息了一年，现已重返工作。
text.en: After a year off when her son was born, she has gone back to work.

text.zh: 已与 Mick 离婚，独自抚养一段短暂恋情所生的儿子 Charlie。
text.en: Divorced from Mick, she is raising Charlie, her son from a brief relationship, as a single mother.

text.zh: 与 Mick 离婚，生下儿子 Charlie；母亲在她 30 岁时去世。
text.en: Divorced Mick and had her son Charlie; her mother died when Jackie was 30.

text.zh: 此前一直在苏格兰工作，类风湿关节炎让她暂停了工作。
text.en: Was working in Scotland until recently; rheumatoid arthritis has put work on hold.

text.zh: 有三个儿子 Charlie、James 和 Lee；已与小儿子们的父亲 Ian 分手。
text.en: Has three sons, Charlie, James and Lee; she and Ian, father of the younger two, have split up.

text.zh: 住在苏格兰 Newmains，距格拉斯哥约 40 分钟车程。
text.en: Lives in Newmains, Scotland, about a 40-minute drive from Glasgow.

text.zh: 随 Ian 迁居苏格兰并又生两子；两人后来分手，她被诊断出类风湿关节炎。
text.en: Moved to Scotland with Ian and had two more sons; they then split up, and she was diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis.

text.zh: 她说病痛让她消沉，但生活不会：她有三个好儿子和爱她的家人。
text.en: She says her illness gets her down, but not her life: she has three wonderful boys and a loving family.

text.zh: 患类风湿关节炎，靠残疾福利金生活。
text.en: Has rheumatoid arthritis and lives off disability benefit.

text.zh: 与 Ian 分开后在其家人附近抚养三个儿子；她说现任伴侣绝不会上镜。
text.en: Separated from Ian, she raises her three sons near his family; she says her current partner will never take part.

text.zh: 住在苏格兰一处底层住房，离婆婆 Liz 很近。
text.en: Lives in Scotland, in a ground-floor home close to her mother-in-law, Liz.

text.zh: 因关节炎搬进底层住房；她在镜头前质疑导演对她的呈现方式。
text.en: Moved to a ground-floor home because of her arthritis; on camera she challenges how the director has portrayed her.

text.zh: 她觉得自己比导演预想的更聪明，并说对如今的人生状态感到满意。
text.en: She feels cleverer than the director expected and says she has reached a level in life she is happy with.

text.zh: 靠残疾福利金生活已逾 14 年；福利复审却判定她能工作。
text.en: Has lived on disability benefits for over 14 years; a benefits review has declared her fit to work.

text.zh: 三个儿子都有工作；儿子 James 的女儿是她第一个孙辈；她说想找个伴。
text.en: Her three sons all work; son James's daughter is her first grandchild; she says she would like a relationship.

text.zh: 仍与家人住在苏格兰同一地区。
text.en: Still lives in the same area of Scotland as the rest of the family.

text.zh: 孩子父亲 Ian 确诊癌症晚期，又在孙女出生前三天遭遇车祸重伤身亡。
text.en: Ian, the boys' father, was diagnosed with stage-four cancer, then fatally injured in a road accident three days before his granddaughter's birth.

text.zh: 她说自己的杯子永远半满，人生苦短，相信自己的生活会很好。
text.en: She says her glass is always half full, life is too short, and she thinks her life is going to be good.

text.zh: 领取残疾福利金已超过 20 年。
text.en: Has been getting disability benefits for over 20 years.

text.zh: 三个儿子都有工作，两个仍与她同住；她已有孙辈，单身已久。
text.en: Her three sons all work, two still living with her; she has grandchildren and has been on her own a long while.

text.zh: 仍与家人住在苏格兰同一地区。
text.en: Still lives in the same area of Scotland as her family.

text.zh: 她讲述父亲停药后去世，以及近四年半后 Ian 车祸案终获有罪判决。
text.en: She recounts her father's death after he stopped his medication, and a guilty verdict over Ian's death after nearly four and a half years.

text.zh: 她觉得自己从没真正变过，一直爱说话，并后悔没多读书。
text.en: She feels she has never really changed, always talkative, and regrets not doing more education.

text.zh: 已退休；她说现在有机会享受退休生活。
text.en: Retired; she says she now has the chance to enjoy her retirement.

text.zh: 有新伴侣 Eddie，儿时就相识；她为三个儿子骄傲，常与儿孙见面。
text.en: Has a new partner, Eddie, known since childhood; proud of her three sons, she sees them and her grandchildren a lot.

text.zh: 住在诺福克一处退休社区里属于自己的住所。
text.en: Lives in her own place in a retirement complex in Norfolk.

text.zh: 为求清静从苏格兰搬到诺福克，并经朋友与儿时旧识 Eddie 重新联系上。
text.en: Moved from Scotland to Norfolk for some peace, and reconnected through a friend with Eddie, whom she knew as a child.

text.zh: 她说最骄傲的是三个儿子，并强调他们是“她的”孩子。
text.en: She says she is most proud of her three boys, stressing that they are her boys.

text.zh: 已退休，住在诺福克的一处退休社区，有一位儿时就相识的新伴侣，并为三个儿子感到骄傲。
text.en: Retired and living in a retirement complex in Norfolk, she has a new partner she knew as a child and is proud of her three sons.
